fields.name: heroImageAlt
fields.label: Hero image alt text
fields.description: Briefly describe the image for visitors using a screen reader.

fields.name: dither
fields.label: Image treatment
fields.description: Live dither settings. These use the same values as Dither studio.

fields.name: enabled
fields.label: Enable treatment
fields.description: Turn this off to display the original image.

fields.name: tint
fields.label: Tint
fields.description: 0–100. At 100 the light marks use the accent color.

fields.name: patternSize
fields.label: Pattern size
fields.description: 6–30. Larger values make the dither pattern coarser.

fields.name: brightness
fields.label: Brightness
fields.description: 0.2–1.5. The Dither studio default is 0.6.

fields.name: contrast
fields.label: Contrast
fields.description: 0.5–2. The Dither studio default is 1.

fields.name: scale
fields.label: Scale
fields.description: 100–300 percent. The image always covers its frame.

fields.name: positionX
fields.label: Horizontal framing
fields.description: 0–100 percent. 50 keeps the image centered.

fields.name: positionY
fields.label: Vertical framing
fields.description: 0–100 percent. 50 keeps the image centered.

fields.name: scheduleLabel
fields.label: Schedule list label
fields.description: Generated automatically from the date, start time, and title.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Room name
fields.description: As displayed, e.g. "B2.0.1" or "B1 - Aula Castiglioni"

fields.name: roomNumber
fields.label: Room number
fields.description: Optional — omit for rooms named after a person

fields.name: city
fields.label: City
fields.description: Optional

fields.name: country
fields.label: Country
fields.description: Optional (e.g. "Scotland, UK")

fields.name: venue
fields.label: Hosting venue
fields.description: Optional
